names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 23 aprilie, «Sfântul Mare Mucenic Gheorghe, Purtătorul de biruință».
Read out of saint.gr's line for 23 Απριλίου, «Άγιος Γεώργιος ο Μεγαλομάρτυρας και Τροπαιοφόρος», with the rank word and the epithets left off.

Read out of the Охридски пролог's heading for 23. април ст. ст., „Св. вел. муч. Ђорђе.“, with „Св.“ and the ranks вел. муч. left off — великомученик is the `great-martyr` this folder carries in `types`. The heading gives no epithet: Тропајоносац, the Trophy-bearer this corpus's English name keeps, is not in it, and the body's „победоносни“ is an adjective in a sentence. The Serbian vernacular Ђорђе is what this book prints, not Георгије, which eight other folders hold; `george-of-kratovo` holds the fuller «Ђорђе Кратовац» and no folder held this bare form before.

Read out of the title on the name link behind the line for 23 апреля ст. ст., name page 497, «Великомученик Георгий Победоносец», with the rank word left off; the day’s own line gives the genitive «Георгия Победоносца». Победоносец, the Trophy-bearer, is kept because the calendar prints it attached to the name and because the bare «Георгий» would fold onto a great many folders. Measured against the gate’s own key function before it was written: 'георгии победоносец' has no other holder in the corpus.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 23 апреля ст. ст. — «Вмч. Георгия Победоносца (303).»
source.note: The day’s second entry, after the moveable Преполовение Пятидесятницы. The name link behind the line, page 497, is titled «Великомученик Георгий Победоносец» and gives «День памяти: 23 апреля» and no other day, so there is no second day to record. The index it links lists two readings and both were read: life6415, a short notice of his companions, and life918, titled for him and five of his company together — «Великомученик Георгий Победоносец. Мученики Анатолий и Протолеон, Гликерий земледелец, Афанасий волхв и Валерий». THE DAY PAGE PRINTS THREE HYMNS UNDER HIS NAME and all three are on this folder now; two of them name nobody in their own text and are taken as his under the page’s own headings, which is BRIEF.md §4’s common and not a mis-hang, and the hymn notes say which is which. The year 303 is the folder’s already and `dates` was not changed; life918 gives the day as well, «Это было 23 апреля 303 года», and adds that he was not yet thirty. Not checked: azbyka.ru.

source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 23 aprilie — «Sfântul Mare Mucenic Gheorghe, Purtătorul de biruință»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 23ης Απριλίου — «Άγιος Γεώργιος ο Μεγαλομάρτυρας και Τροπαιοφόρος»

attestations.note: **The feast type on his page is not the plain fixed one**: «Ειδικός υπολογισμός. Εορτάζει στις 23 Απριλίου εκάστου έτους. Εάν όμως η εορτή πέσει πρίν το Πάσχα, τότε εορτάζει την επόμενη μέρα του Πάσχα (Δευτέρα της Δικαινησίμου)» — a special reckoning: he is kept on 23 April every year, but if the feast should fall before Pascha then he is kept on the day after Pascha, Bright Monday. The fixed 23 April is the day the listing and the page both give and is what this row records; the Paschal transfer is a rule about particular years and has no field in this schema. It is the same day the Romanian calendar keeps him. **This folder had no `dates` and now has both years** off the page's heading «(275 - 303)» and its opening sentence. The page names Cappadocia for his birth and Palestine for his mother's country and estates, makes his father die a martyr when he was ten, has him enlist at eighteen and rise to the title of count under Diocletian, who esteemed him. Under «Πολιούχος» it lists twelve Greek towns that hold him patron, and under «Ιερά Λείψανα» ten resting places of portions of his relics, on Athos at Iviron, Xenophontos and Zographou, at the monastery of St George of Pheneos in Corinthia, at the metropolis of Thebes and Levadeia, at the church of St George of the Greeks in Venice, at the Trinity–St Sergius and St Alexander Nevsky Lavras, and at three Roman Catholic houses in Venice and Ferrara and at Velabro in Rome. The day's other entries tie eight more people to his passion, and each of them now has a folder. It prints one apolytikion and one kontakion, both proper to him, and both are stored here.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 06.05.2026 (23. април ст. ст.) — „Св. вел. муч. Ђорђе.“

attestations.note: **A SECOND DAY ON THIS CHURCH, ADDED 7 OCTOBER 2026, AND THE ROW ITSELF IS COPIED BACK BYTE FOR BYTE** — same day, same month, same source, same url, same year. `BRIEF.md` section 4 allows a reader to write this note on a row that is already `venerated`, under `replace_venerated: true`, and nothing else under this key is changed: one attestation row per church is the schema, this church’s row stays on the Julian 23 April, and he does not render on the November day. The Охридски пролог keeps him AGAIN on the Julian 3 November, in its second entry of that day, headed „Св. великомуч. Георгије.“ — Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 16.11.2025 (3. новембар ст. ст.) — „Св. великомуч. Георгије.“, https://www.pravoslavno.rs/index.php?q=citanja&datum=2025-11-16&prolog=1 — AND THAT ENTRY SAYS IN ITS FIRST WORDS WHAT THE DAY IS: «Овога дана празнује се пренос моштију св. Георгија из Никомидије (данас Измит, Турска) у град Лиду Палестинску, где пострада у време цара Диоклецијана.» — on this day is celebrated the TRANSLATION OF THE RELICS of St George from Nicomedia, today Izmit in Turkey, to the city of Lydda in Palestine. BRIEF-SERBIAN section 5 is explicit that «Пренос моштију» is a feast and not a folder, so no second folder and no second row; and the entry refers the reader to the passion itself under 23 April, which is the day this row stands on. WHAT THAT ENTRY ADDS TO THIS FOLDER, AND IT IS THE WHOLE OF THE TRANSLATION. Before his death George begged his servant to take his body after he died and carry it to Palestine, WHERE HIS MOTHER WAS FROM and where he had a great estate, which he had given away to the poor; and the servant did so. In the time of the emperor Constantine a beautiful church of St George was built at Lydda by pious Christians, and at the consecration of that church the relics of the saint were translated into it and buried there; and countless wonders have come from them. **AND THIS BOOK SPELLS HIM TWO WAYS ON ITS OWN TWO DAYS, WHICH IS A QUESTION AND NOT A SECOND FORM.** The 23 April heading prints «Ђорђе», which is the `sr` form this folder stores; this 3 November heading prints «Георгије». Both are bare and neither is fuller, and section 6 allows ONE `sr` form per folder, so NO SECOND FORM WAS ADDED — it would also have made a two-member fold with `george-of-mytilene`, measured with `sr-foldpred.mjs`, out of nothing but a spelling. AUTHOR: one book, one man, two spellings on two of its own days, and the rule as written has no room for the second. No `dates`, `types`, `office`, `related` or `locations` was touched: Diocletian and Constantine are emperors named to date two events, and the mother the entry points to without naming is `polychronia-mother-of-george`, already `related` here in both directions.

hymns.text: Ca un izbăvitor al celor robiţi şi celor săraci ocrotitor, celor bolnavi doctor, împăraţilor ajutător, purtătorule de biruinţă, Mare Mucenice Gheorghe, roagă pe Hristos Dumnezeu să mântuiască sufletele noastre.

source.text: Doxologia — Troparul Sfântului Mare Mucenic Gheorghe, Purtătorul de biruință

english.text: As a deliverer of the captive and a protector of the poor, a physician to the sick and a helper of kings, trophy-bearing Great Martyr George, pray to Christ God that our souls be saved.

hymns.text: Ὡς τῶν αἰχμαλώτων ἐλευθερωτής, καὶ τῶν πτωχῶν ὑπερασπιστής, ἀσθενούντων ἰατρός, βασιλέων ὑπέρμαχος, Τροπαιοφόρε Μεγαλομάρτυς Γεώργιε, πρέσβευε Χριστῷ τῷ Θεῷ, σωθῆναι τὰς ψυχὰς ἡμῶν.

source.text: saint.gr, Ἀπολυτίκιον (Κατέβασμα), Ἦχος δ’, on the page of «Άγιος Γεώργιος ο Μεγαλομάρτυρας και Τροπαιοφόρος»

english.text: As the liberator of captives and the defender of the poor, the physician of the sick and the champion of kings, O trophy-bearing great martyr George, intercede with Christ God that our souls be saved.

hymns.text: Γεωργηθείς ὑπό Θεοῦ ἀνεδείχθης, τῆς εὐσεβείας γεωργός Τιμιώτατος, τῶν ἀρετῶν τὰ δράγματα συλλέξας σεαυτῷ· σπείρας γὰρ ἐν δάκρυσιν, εὐφροσύνῃ θερίζεις· ἀθλήσας δὲ δι᾽ αἵματος, τὸν Χριστόν ἐκομίσω· καὶ ταῖς πρεσβείαις Ἅγιε ταῖς σαῖς, πᾶσι παρέχεις πταισμάτων συγχώρησιν.

source.text: saint.gr, Κοντάκιον, Ἦχος δ’, Ὁ ὑψωθείς ἐν τῷ Σταυρῷ, on the page of «Άγιος Γεώργιος ο Μεγαλομάρτυρας και Τροπαιοφόρος»

english.text: Being tilled by God thou wast shown a most honourable husbandman of piety, gathering to thyself the sheaves of the virtues; for having sown in tears thou reapest in gladness, and having contended through thy blood thou hast won Christ. And by thine intercessions, O holy one, thou grantest to all the forgiveness of their trespasses.

hymns.text: Яко пленных свободитель/ и нищих защититель,/ немощствующих врач,/ православных поборниче,/ победоносче, великомучениче Георгие,/ моли Христа Бога// спастися душам нашим.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 23 апреля ст. ст. — «Тропарь великомученика Георгия», глас 4, under «Молитвы»
source.note: The first of the three the day prints under his name, and the only one of them whose own text names him, «победоносче, великомучениче Георгие». It is the Slavonic of the troparion this folder already carries in Romanian and in Greek. Copied whole off the page and checked back against it by whitespace-normalised match.

english.text: As the deliverer of captives and the defender of the poor, the physician of the sick and the champion of the Orthodox, O victorious great-martyr George, pray to Christ God that our souls may be saved.

hymns.text: Подвигом добрым подвизался еси,/ страстотерпче Христов,/ верою и мучителей обличил еси нечестие,/ жертва же благоприятна Богу принеслся еси./ Темже и венец приял еси победы/ и молитвами, святе, твоими всем подавши/ прегрешений прощение.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 23 апреля ст. ст. — «Ин тропарь великомученика Георгия Победоносца», глас 4, under «Молитвы»
source.note: «Ин тропарь» is the page’s own word for a second troparion. THE TEXT NAMES NOBODY: it addresses a «страстотерпче Христов», a passion-bearer of Christ, and is recognisably the common of a passion-bearer. It is taken whole under the page’s own heading, which is BRIEF.md §4’s ruling that a common printed under one name is that saint’s service; it is reported as a common and not as his proper. Copied whole off the page and checked back against it.

english.text: Thou didst strive in the good struggle, O passion-bearer of Christ, and by faith thou didst convict thy tormentors of their impiety; thou wast offered as a sacrifice acceptable to God. Therefore hast thou received the crown of victory, and by thy prayers, O holy one, thou grantest unto all forgiveness of transgressions.

hymns.text: Возделан от Бога,/ показался еси благочестия делатель честнейший,/ добродетелей рукояти собрав себе:/ сеяв бо в слезах, веселием жнеши,/ страдальчествовав же кровию, Христа приял еси,/ молитвами, святе, твоими всем подаеши// прегрешений прощение.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 23 апреля ст. ст. — «Кондак великомученика Георгия», глас 4, under «Молитвы»
source.note: THE TEXT NAMES NOBODY, addressing a «святе» who sowed in tears and reaped in gladness and strove unto blood; it is taken whole under the page’s own heading, as the second troparion is, and it is the Slavonic of the kontakion this folder already carries in Greek, at the same tone. Copied whole off the page and checked back against it.

english.text: Cultivated by God, thou wast shown forth a most honourable husbandman of piety, gathering to thyself the sheaves of the virtues; for having sown in tears thou reapest in gladness, and having striven unto blood thou hast received Christ. By thy prayers, O holy one, thou grantest unto all forgiveness of transgressions.

birth.note: saint.gr: «γεννήθηκε περίπου το 275 μ.Χ. στην Καππαδοκία, από γονείς χριστιανούς», and the page heads him «(275 - 303)»; the page's own word is περίπου, about.

death.note: saint.gr heads him «Αγιος Γεωργιος ο Μεγαλομαρτυρας Και Τροπαιοφορος (275 - 303)».
